scope: MEAS: independent numerical, report/source, published note/bar-map, actual-sheet and visual review; not aural review.

defects.finding: The rendered page lacks the source-encoded first-strain repeat signs. The original spacer voice uses repeat volta count 1 around the eight full bars after the pickup; modern engraving suppresses its intended markers, while the performed map correctly repeats those bars.
defects.requiredFix: Restore the repeat beginning after pickup 0 at bar 1 and ending after 8 with a guarded notation-only compatibility repair. Preserve the pitched source expressions, exact 0–8 / 1–24 traversal, 25 printed bar identities and 129-quarter grid while separately repairing the extraction defect below. Document and inspect both restored signs.

defects.finding: Source classification identifies five genuine attacks omitted from the legacy MIDI: main C5 at q31 after a same-pitch acciaccatura; G4 at q42, D5 at q58 and D5 at q88.5 against another voice's held unisons; and the second A3 grace just before q22, tied onward. They are not disposable coincident-onset duplicates.
defects.requiredFix: Extract all unchanged named logical piano voices independently and audit their complete attack/tie inventory. Preserve both reattacks and overlapping source holds; preserve the A3 grace as an attack tied onward, not an invented additional main-note reattack. Retain immutable downloads, document the original MIDI's omissions, then re-align and re-publish only after unchanged gates and exact printed-bar coverage pass. Do not merely insert these five notes as special cases or keep an incomplete canonical MIDI to avoid regeneration.

report.finding: Current 449-event published checks pass numerically and disclose the two non-independent fitting constraints, but known written attacks are absent from the legacy MIDI. The report must record complete source-voice extraction and repeat-visibility restoration with fresh final counts/gates before acceptance.

barMap.finding: All 449 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index identities are pickup 0 and 1–24. The complete page was inspected, including the bar-22 fermata and final cadence. Seconds-based formal labels can precede full-bar downbeats because their melodic pickups lie in the previous bar; no unresolved structured bar pointers occur.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified in the final constrained candidate. The late C5/A5 melodic rises now precede the bar-22 held harmony in the appropriate order. The two fitting anchors are not independent validation. The genuine final F2/A3/F4 attack remains near 193.146 s; its written two-quarter duration to the estimated 200.92 s decay end is not a measured key release.

version.finding: Complete-form piano No. 7 traversal: pickup, first eight full bars repeated, later return written out. The current printed repeat omission and incomplete source-event inventory prevent acceptance despite coherent aggregate timing.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the symbolic-source edition is not identified as Betts’s physical performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Passing constrained timing gates does not establish correct conversion of legacy engraving directives or physical note releases.
